incidents.summary: The Financial Ombudsman Service found that Ascentric, acquired by M&G in 2020, failed to identify CFB bonds as non-standard, speculative investments during due diligence.

sources.title: M&G initiates legal action against Royal London over risky investments
sources.quote: In March 2024, the FOS concluded that Ascentric’s due diligence failed to identify the CFB bonds as non-standard and speculative, posing a high risk of consumer detriment.

sources.title: M&G initiates legal action against Royal London over risky investments
sources.quote: M&G, which announced the acquisition of Ascentric with £15.5bn ($19.42bn) in assets in 2020, is now facing regulatory pressure to compensate affected clients.

sources.title: M&G initiates legal action against Royal London over risky investments
sources.quote: M&G’s lawsuit states that these bonds lacked a liquid market outside of IFDL’s platform, leading to customer complaints about the inability to sell them and their classification as “minibonds,” which are known for being high-risk.

incidents.summary: M&G faced a formal FCA complaint alleging that it failed to defend Eros Media World bondholders’ interests while acting as trustee.

sources.title: M&G under fire over Eros Media World Bollywood bond drama | This is Money
